data_bindings.binding: Use the frozen prospective extension symbols, M5 resolution, and initial eight-week interval exactly.
Use only the accepted Pepperstone account-native feasible non-test universe and its account fingerprint.

minimal_acquisition_request.information_gain_justification: This is the smallest already-authorized frontier extension that broadens asset-class and mechanism exposure beyond the observed six-symbol panel while preserving a common M5 horizon and an eight-week minimum development window. It directly tests whether the narrow-panel limitation is masking structurally viable broker-native opportunities without opening economics or consuming a new exact identity.

decision.research_scope: Structural screening only; no economic candidate creation, no parameter tuning against outcomes, no rerun of C031 Stage-B, and no reuse of the completed six-symbol outer result as a new confirmatory dataset.

screening_semantics.capital_accounting: No simulated or live capital allocation is opened by this proposal; any later economics must use one continuous EUR200 account model with external cashflows separated from strategy NAV and explicit margin/free-margin accounting.
screening_semantics.economic_interpretation: Forbidden until a separately frozen methodology, candidate-independent friction authority, and prospective evaluation authorize it.
screening_semantics.external_gate: Capture the exact frozen symbol set and interval from the authorized Pepperstone account through the cTrader/Open API collector, validate account fingerprint and read-only integrity, then return for deterministic acceptance before any outcome-derived interpretation.
screening_semantics.purpose: Measure data sufficiency, schedule-adjusted coverage, chronology integrity, opportunity density, cross-asset heterogeneity, and structural signal persistence across the broader feasible broker-native surface.

capture_must_be: account-bound to the accepted Pepperstone fingerprint
free of synthetic fills and forward filling
chronologically auditable with duplicate and conflict detection
next_research_state.promotion_gate: Do not create an economic identity or authorize an outer economic evaluation from this capture alone; first assess structural sufficiency and information gain under the frozen screening and multiple-testing rules.

objective.goal: Extend structural opportunity screening beyond the narrow six-symbol outer panel using the frozen successor frontier, while preserving the distinction between descriptive research evidence and economic validation.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The completed outer result is limited to one fixed six-symbol session-gap panel and cannot establish family exhaustion. The accepted broker-native universe contains 1641 feasible non-test symbols, while the frozen 12-symbol extension spans additional asset classes and structural regimes. A minimal eight-week M5 capture can test whether viable structural opportunity density exists outside the observed panel before any new economic identity or broad expensive evaluation is considered.
